info.title: Kunai API
info.description: Track the books, movies, series, games, anime and manga you read, watch and play. Errors are problem details with a stable "code"; see docs/errors.md.

get.description: Hits that are already in the catalog carry their id; for the rest, call /items/import with the ref. Debounce input (300 ms) and send at least 2 characters.

put.summary: Add an item to my shelf or replace its entry
put.description: 201 when created, 200 when replaced. Send If-Match with the ETag to avoid overwriting a change made on another device (412 on mismatch); send If-None-Match: * to only create.

code.description: Stable code: white, yellow, orange, green, blue, brown, black.

minPoints.description: Points needed to reach this belt.

color.description: Hex color used to paint the avatar's belt.

CatalogStatus.description: Manually added items wait for a moderator before other users can find them.

target.description: How many to complete this year.

code.description: Stable snake_case error code to switch on and translate.

traceId.description: Identifies the request in logs; include it in bug reports.

ref.description: The "ref" of a search result, e.g. "tmdb:movie:603".

coverUrl.description: HTTPS cover image, hosted by the provider.

genres.description: Genres as the provider names them.

progressTotal.description: Pages, episodes or chapters, when known.

ref.description: Provider reference such as "tmdb:movie:603"; null for manual items.

catalogStatus.description: approved, or pendingReview/rejected for manual items.

details.description: Type-specific fields; the ones that do not apply are null.

ItemSource.description: Where an item's metadata comes from.

ItemSummary.description: The few item fields a shelf or profile list needs.

statuses.description: The statuses this type allows, in display order, with their labels.

oneOf.description: What progress counts (pages, episodes...); null when progress is not tracked.

rankPoints.description: Belt points earned for each completed item of this type.

LocalizedText.description: A label in both languages, so one cacheable response serves every client.

useCookie.description: True for browsers: the session lives in an httpOnly cookie instead of tokens.

deviceName.description: Optional label shown in the device list, e.g. "iPhone 17".

isbn13.description: 13 digits, no dashes; checked with its check digit.

code.description: Stable snake_case error code to switch on and translate.

traceId.description: Identifies the request in logs; include it in bug reports.

errors.description: Field name (camelCase) to error codes; present on validation problems.

avatarUrl.description: Relative URL of the ninja avatar, painted with the current belt.

rank.description: Current belt and progress to the next one.

thisYear.description: Items completed this calendar year (in the user's time zone).

nextCode.description: The next belt, or null at black belt.

nextAt.description: Points needed for the next belt, or null at black belt.

username.description: 3-24 characters: lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.

password.description: 12-128 characters. Passwords found in known breaches are rejected.

ref.description: Provider reference; send it to /items/import when Id is null. Null for manually added books.

id.description: The catalog id when the item was already imported.

subtitle.description: Secondary line: authors, original title, platforms...

items.description: Search hits in the provider's relevance order.

nextCursor.description: Pass as "cursor" to get the next page; null on the last page.

isProfilePublic.description: Private profiles answer 404 to everyone else.

startedOn.description: Calendar date in the user's time zone (yyyy-MM-dd).

finishedOn.description: Calendar date in the user's time zone; counts toward that year's stats and goals.

progress.description: Pages, episodes, chapters or percent, depending on the item type (see /item-types).

ShelfEntryRequest.description: The full state of a shelf entry; PUT replaces every field.

nextCursor.description: Pass as "cursor" for the next page; null on the last page.

totalCount.description: How many entries match the filters in total.

ShelfStatus.description: One status vocabulary for every type; each type allows a subset and labels it its own way.

notice.description: Attribution text that must be shown where the data appears.

availableYears.description: Years with at least one completion, newest first.

types.description: Completions and average rating per type.

pagesRead.description: Total pages of the books completed (when the page count is known).

episodesWatched.description: Total episodes of the series and anime completed.

chaptersRead.description: Total chapters of the manga completed.

accessToken.description: ES256 JWT; send it as "Authorization: Bearer ...".

refreshToken.description: Single use. Exchange it at /auth/refresh before the session expires; never refresh twice in parallel.

username.description: The normalized (lowercase) username that was checked.

available.description: True when the username can be registered right now.

reason.description: username_invalid, username_reserved or username_taken when not available.

Bearer.description: Native apps: the access token from /auth/login or /auth/refresh.

Cookie.description: Web app: set by /auth/login with useCookie=true. Requests that change data must also send 'X-CSRF: 1'.
